newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai cabinet picks new central bank governor.
newsitem.headline: Thai cabinet picks new central bank governor.

text.p: Thailand's cabinet on Tuesday appointed deputy Bank of Thailand governor Chaiyawat Wibulswasdi to succeed outgoing governor Rerngchai Marakanond, deputy interior minister Chalerm Yubamrung said.
Rerngchai quit on Monday and his resignation was accepted by the government on Tuesday.
Rerngchai, who was governor for just over a year, resigned while under pressure following the baht's disastrous showing after it was put into a managed float from a peg to a basket of currencies.
He also faced criticism for his handling of the troubled financial sector, which has been hit by a liquidity crunch and overexposure to the depressed property sector as the economy went into a slump.
Chaiyawat, 50, joined the central bank in 1973.
He was briefly appointed deputy finance minister in 1996 by a caretaker government before a general election. He was later transferred back to the central bank.
